latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Image to Video LLM (v1.0.0): convert still images into animated video clips via cloud AI.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC uploads up to 200MB; generates 5-second 1080p MP4 videos in under 2 minutes.
- No manual video editing or animation skills required; describe the output you want and get results automatically.
- Designed for marketers, social media creators, and designers to create smooth animated clips from photos.
- Includes automatic cloud setup with free NEMO_TOKEN (100 credits, 7 days), session management, and simple prompts to export or edit videos.
